leaseText: This Office Lease Agreement is made between Landlord One Corporation, as Landlord, and Tenant Two LLC, as Tenant, for the premises described as Suite 400, 5,200 rentable square feet in the building located at 100 Example Street. The Term is five years, commencing January 1, 2026, and expiring December 31, 2030. Base Rent is forty-eight thousand dollars per annum, payable in equal monthly installments in advance. Rent shall escalate three percent annually on each anniversary. Tenant shall have one option to renew for an additional three-year term, exercisable by written notice at least one hundred twenty days prior to expiration. The premises shall be used for general office purposes only. Tenant is responsible for interior maintenance and repairs; Landlord is responsible for the structure, roof, and building systems. Tenant shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least two million dollars. Assignment and subletting require Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. Landlord may terminate this Lease upon thirty days written notice following an uncured default by Tenant.
